args.body: Use the queued director-byte-isolated-control.json if it commits, or reuse an equivalent completed trial. If the clean control passes and the modified control shows exactly the two expected failures, use that execution for the private buyer report and acknowledge the extra formatting failure in the earlier fixture without asserting its cause. Otherwise include every observed failure or disclose the execution gap. Finish the existing trial with a keep, narrow or withdraw decision and exact private scope wording. Keep CAD 60 provisional and all-in effort unknown unless measured. Read the committed report and receipt before closing under a valid lease with a lesson. Any later public change requires host-enforced independent exact-digest review.
